troubleshooting_rules.symptom: Bike start nahi ho rahi (Self start & kick not working)
troubleshooting_rules.safety_first_step: Check if fuel valve is ON and kill switch is in RUN position.

troubleshooting_rules.symptom: Engine temperature gauge in RED / Steam from bonnet
troubleshooting_rules.safety_first_step: Immediately pull over to a safe shoulder, turn OFF engine, and NEVER open radiator cap while hot.
Turn OFF the main MCB breaker immediately to prevent electrical fire.

troubleshooting_rules.symptom: Concealed wall pipe leak / Continuous tap drip
troubleshooting_rules.safety_first_step: Shut off the overhead water tank main stopcock valve.

troubleshooting_rules.symptom: AC indoor unit running but blowing warm air
troubleshooting_rules.safety_first_step: Clean indoor mesh filters and check if outdoor fan unit is spinning.

troubleshooting_rules.symptom: Freezer freezing but bottom food compartment warm
troubleshooting_rules.safety_first_step: Ensure air vents inside fridge are not blocked with bulky food items.

troubleshooting_rules.symptom: Washing machine fills with water but does not drain or spin
possible_causes: Coin/lint clogged in drain pump filter
troubleshooting_rules.safety_first_step: Unscrew the bottom drain filter cap and clear out coins or lint debris.

troubleshooting_rules.symptom: Laptop screen shows Blue Screen (BSOD) or boots to BIOS
troubleshooting_rules.safety_first_step: Disconnect external USB drives and power cycle.

troubleshooting_rules.symptom: RO purifier constant beep alarm or zero pure water flow
troubleshooting_rules.safety_first_step: Check raw inlet tap water pressure and pre-filter sediment bowl.
